bullet: Fork tags agree with the stored metadata (`F10.fork-tags-consistent`), known bug.
script:
TS=$(control-agent-server conversation start --placeholder-agent --no-autotitle --no-run --tag qa=src --prompt QA_F10_TAGS --print-id)
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$TS" --quiet --check tags.qa eq src
control-agent-server state cat meta.json --conversation "$TS" --check tags.qa eq src
TF=$(control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$TS/fork" --json '{"title": "QA F10 tag fork"}' --expect 201 --quiet \
  --check tags.title eq 'QA F10 tag fork' --save F10.fork-tags-consistent/fork --field id)
TF_QA=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$TF" --field tags | python3 -c 'import json, sys; v = json.load(sys.stdin).get("qa"); print("null" if v is None else v)')
control-agent-server state cat meta.json --conversation "$TF" --check title eq 'QA F10 tag fork' --check tags.qa eq "$TF_QA"  # bug
failed_command: control-agent-server state cat meta.json --conversation "$TF" --check title eq 'QA F10 tag fork' --check tags.qa eq "$TF_QA"
